headline: Prof Nurul Islam named new VC of Jahangirnagar University
summary: The Ministry of Education has appointed the former VC of Dhaka Central University to lead the university for a four-year term.
details: Prof Md Nurul Islam, from the Department of Geography and Environment, has been appointed as the new vice-chancellor of Jahangirnagar University.
The appointment was announced in a notification issued by the Ministry of Education's Secondary and Higher Education Division on Saturday.
Prof Nurul Islam previously served as the vice-chancellor of Dhaka Central University and has been relieved of that position to take on this new role.
His term will be effective from the date he assumes office and will continue for four years or until his retirement, whichever comes first.
As the university's chief executive officer, the vice-chancellor is required to remain on the university campus on a full-time basis.
The appointment was made with the approval of the president, who serves as the chancellor of public universities.
caption:
A new leader for Jahangirnagar University. Prof Nurul Islam takes over as VC.

Prof Md Nurul Islam, from the Department of Geography and Environment, has been appointed as the new vice-chancellor of Jahangirnagar University.

The appointment was announced in a notification issued by the Ministry of Education's Secondary and Higher Education Division on Saturday.

Prof Nurul Islam previously served as the vice-chancellor of Dhaka Central University and has been relieved of that position to take on this new role.

His term will be effective from the date he assumes office and will continue for four years or until his retirement, whichever comes first.

As the university's chief executive officer, the vice-chancellor is required to remain on the university campus on a full-time basis.

The appointment was made with the approval of the president, who serves as the chancellor of public universities.

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com

headline: Home Minister: Police aiding fascist forces to face treason charges
summary: Some police officers are secretly providing information to fascist forces, says Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan. Those found guilty will face treason charges.
details: Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan has revealed that intelligence indicates some police personnel are secretly collaborating with fascist elements. He stated that such actions, if proven, will be treated as treason and dealt with accordingly under the law.

Speaking at the Police Week 2026 medal ceremony at Rajarbagh Police Auditorium, the minister emphasized the need for police to be strict in fulfilling public expectations. He warned that officers failing to understand and meet these expectations would face severe consequences.

Khan also addressed reports of dereliction of duty and failure to perform duties at the grassroots level. He assured that measures are being taken gradually, and police members are being given opportunities to reform their conduct.

The minister urged police not to behave like "feudal lords" but to be public-friendly. He stressed that senior officers must not engage in activities that appear abnormal or undemocratic to the public, and subordinates should not be allowed or encouraged to do so.

Highlighting the government's strong foundation, built on democratic principles and public support, Khan stated the administration believes in a policy of reward and punishment. He acknowledged that while perfect justice may not always be achievable, the message is clear.

The minister reiterated his message to all police ranks, from the grassroots to the IGP: "Police must be strict to maintain discipline and fulfill public expectations." He noted that fascist forces have historically misused and politically exploited the police, forcing some officers to follow illegal orders.
Khan clarified that disciplinary actions would not be the only consequence. Criminal cases will be filed for any offenses committed, alongside departmental actions, punishments, and reprimands.
The event also saw 98 individuals awarded BPM and PPM medals for their bravery, valor, and service.
